1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a plurality of precoders from a codebook in a transmitter having an antenna array; transforming each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q(w) = w^H·Z·w with respect to the corresponding precoder w, where the quadratic form is based on a transmission line impedance of a transmission line between a signal source and the antenna array, __and where the transformation is performed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of the transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied__; receiving a signal from the signal source; applying a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel; and transmitting the precoded signal.

2. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the quadratic form is also based on __at least one of__ an impedance matrix of the antenna array__,__ a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power, __wherein the transformation matrix is derived from the quadratic form and is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array__.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein the transformation __is performed such that it__ equalizes the transmit power for all of the plurality of precoders __as defined by the quadratic form__.

11. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein transforming transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders __as measured by the quadratic form__ when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.

12. (Currently amended) The method according to claim 1, wherein both data symbol precoders and reference symbol precoders are transformed by the same transformation __derived from the quadratic form__.

13. (Original)

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: an antenna array; a transceiver coupled to the antenna array; a signal source coupled to the transceiver; a transmission line coupled between the signal source and the antenna array, the transmission line having a transmission line impedance; a memory to store a codebook including a plurality of precoders; and a controller coupled to the transceiver and the memory, the controller configured to: receive a plurality of precoders from the codebook, transform each precoder of the plurality of precoders to a transformed precoder such that the transmit power for each transformed precoder is equal to the transmit power for each of other transformed precoders of the plurality of precoders, where the transmit power is expressed as a quadratic form Q(w) = w^H·Z·w with respect to the corresponding precoder w, where the quadratic form is based on the transmission line impedance, __and where the transformation is performed by scaling each precoder by an inverse square root of the transmit power that results from the corresponding precoder before scaling is applied__, receive a signal from the signal source, and apply a transformed precoder of the plurality of transformed precoders to the signal to generate a precoded signal for transmission over a physical channel, wherein the transceiver transmits the precoded signal.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the quadratic form is also based on __at least one of__ an impedance matrix of the antenna array, a matching network between the signal source and the antenna array, an impedance of the antenna array, a signal source impedance, and length of the transmission line.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Cancelled)

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein each precoder is transformed by multiplying each precoder by a transformation matrix such that the resulting set of precoders each map to antenna patterns having the same power, __wherein the transformation matrix is derived from the quadratic form and is based on an impedance matrix of the antenna array seen at the signal source as a function of the transmission line length, the transmission line impedance, and an impedance of the antenna array__.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the controller transforms the precoders to equal energy precoders __as measured by the quadratic form__ when transmission lines are used between a source of the signal and the antenna array.
